parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description:
The edition of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Valid values:

- **0**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Insurance.

- **1**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Unlimited.

- **2**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) CMA.

- **9**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) Professional Edition.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
The service traffic forwarding status of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Valid values:

- **0**: Traffic forwarding is stopped.

- **1**: Traffic is forwarded.

parameters.name: ExpireEndTime
parameters.description: The end of the expiration time range to query. The operation returns only instances that expire on or before this time. The value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: ExpireStartTime
parameters.description: The start of the expiration time range to query. The operation returns only instances that expire after this time. The value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: An array of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance IDs. You can specify up to 200 instance IDs.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of instances to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you omit this parameter, the system uses the default resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: An array of instance statuses for filtering. You can specify up to two statuses.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: An array of tags for filtering instances.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key used for filtering. You can specify up to 200 tags.

- A tag is a key-value pair defined by a tag key (**Key**) and a tag value (**Value**).

- You can use tags to filter instances.

> The **Key** and **Value** parameters for a tag must be specified as a pair.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value used for filtering. You can specify up to 200 tags.

- A tag is a key-value pair defined by a tag key (**Key**) and a tag value (**Value**).

- You can use tags to filter instances.

> The **Key** and **Value** parameters for a tag must be specified as a pair.
